instrument: the Stage-26 scope-lock scanner plus a prose extension; the Stage-26 module itself is a locked artifact and was not modified

missed_by_stage26_patterns_alone.sentence: We predict outcomes in cancer cells.
The finding was confirmed in a second system.
The tool scores a single cell.

why_the_extension_exists: Stage 26's patterns were calibrated on the tool's own surfaces -- code, a model card, a JSON schema. Fired at prose they let three of fifteen forbidden sentences through. The tool's documentation would never say 'cancer cells'; an abstract easily would.
resurvey_note: The locked surfaces are gated under Stage 26's window rule with the EXTENDED patterns. Clause scoping is reported alongside but not gated on them: it is right for prose and wrong for structured text, where it splits a JSON key from the value that negates it. Every clause-scoped hit below was read and is a false positive of that kind.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: The model generalises to new treatments.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: The model is supported for the six observed experimental conditions; anything else returns UNSUPPORTED_TREATMENT.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: Our approach works for any drug.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: Our approach was evaluated on six observed experimental conditions in one cell line.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: We predict outcomes in cancer cells.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: We predict a clone-detection outcome in one BRAF-V600E melanoma cell line, WM989.
Evaluated clone-held-out within WM989; no other cell line was tested.
The model predicts an observed post-treatment clone-detection proxy, not clinical response.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: The tool identifies the best treatment for each clone.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: The tool orders six observed experimental conditions for each clone; this is experimental-condition selection, not treatment recommendation.
This is a research tool for the WM989 experiment and is not a clinical tool.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: A therapeutic recommendation tool for melanoma.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: A research predictor for six observed conditions in one melanoma cell line.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: We estimate the causal effect of each treatment.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: We estimate a predictive association between pretreatment state and a later observed outcome, under clone-held-out evaluation.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: The model outputs a calibrated probability of death.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: The model outputs an uncalibrated future_detection_score; no calibration was frozen or passed.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: Independently replicated in an external cohort.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: No independent biological replication was performed; clone-held-out folds and two endpoint families are not replication.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: The interaction helps uniformly across all six conditions.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: Four of six conditions carry meaningful interaction; Cisplatin is negligible on C1 and Doxorubicin is negative on both endpoints.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: The finding was confirmed in a second system.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: A separately reconstructed reprogramming system gave positive but underpowered supporting evidence; its confirmation gate FAILED.
Rewind supports the result without confirming it; gate 18.3 FAILED at 0.64, audited ~0.45.

near_miss_table.forbidden_sentence: The tool scores a single cell.
near_miss_table.nearest_permitted_phrasing: The tool scores a clone-level pseudobulk profile; a single cell is not an equivalent input.
